name: Silviu's Wedding Cask

source.note: The last cask of the year Elvir was born, hooped by Old Silviu for his daughter's wedding; ours.

summary: A small oak cask, hooped by Old Silviu, of the last good wine of the year Elvir Martikov was born.
text: Silviu's own hoops, and the last of a good year. It is for his daughter Dana's wedding in Vallaki, and it should not be shaken.
